cohort: Eighty-four pregnant females aged 18-35 years, without cardiorespiratory, renal disorders, bradycardia, tachycardia, hypo/hypertension, or hyperglycemia, who were enrolled for cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Intravenous administration of ondansetron significantly reduced the frequency of maternal hypotension in patients undergoing cesarean section under spinal anesthesia compared to the control group.
